resources.string: To record app usage and give you a pause reminder when your vow limit is reached, finish the basic setup first. Notifications, battery, and auto-start are optional reliability boosts.
Why enable this: Tiny Vow needs this system setting to record daily usage for each app.\n\nCurrent status: the basic setup is ready, and usage can be recorded normally.
Why enable this: Tiny Vow needs this system setting to know how long the target app was used today.\n\nHow to enable: tap the button below -> find Tiny Vow in the system list -> enable usage access.
After tapping the button above, open the system Usage Access page, find Tiny Vow, and allow access. The home page refreshes automatically when you return.
This stage does not add system-level hard stops or sync. It focuses on permission checks, target app selection, today usage reading, daily vow storage, and limit reminders.

Why enable this: when a target app reaches its vow limit and is in the foreground, Tiny Vow shows a full-screen reminder to help you pause.\n\nCurrent status: the service is running and vow reminders are active.

Why enable this: when a target app reaches its vow limit in the foreground, this service can show a full-screen reminder to help you bring your attention back.\n\nHow to enable: tap the button below -> find Tiny Vow Reminder Service in the system accessibility service list -> enable the service.

Purpose: some phone vendors tighten background work, which may affect reminder and reminder reliability.\n\nNote: this is optional. Core features still work without it. After tapping the button, look for Auto-start or Allow background activity in system app details.
If reminders or popups stop appearing, check each system setting to make sure permissions were not revoked.
Current status: battery optimization exemption is granted, so background reminders and statistics should be more stable.

Purpose: reduce reminder delays caused by screen-off or battery saving policies.\n\nNote: this is optional. Core features still work without it. After tapping the button, the system decides whether Tiny Vow can be added to the battery allowlist.
Besides the full-screen reminder, Tiny Vow can also leave you a local reminder in the notification shade.\n\nCurrent status: on. Notification reminders can arrive normally.

If you do not want to rely on the full-screen reminder alone, Tiny Vow can also give you a gentler nudge in the notification shade.\n\nHow to enable: tap the button below and allow notification permission in system settings.

Some phone vendors tighten background work. Background start is an optional reliability setting that reduces the chance that timers, reminders, or vow services are cleared by the system. You can skip it and keep the core features.

The battery allowlist is an optional reliability setting. It reduces the chance that reminders and background stats are delayed after system sleep. Tiny Vow still works if you deny or skip it, but some reminders may be less timely.

Tiny Vow reads local app usage data, including package names, app names, foreground usage time, launch counts, sessions, and night usage statistics. This powers daily vows, reports, points, and reminders. By default, the data stays on this device and is not uploaded automatically.

Tiny Vow\'s accessibility service only listens for window changes. It checks whether you entered an app with a configured vow and shows Tiny Vow\'s reminder page when the vow limit is reached. It does not read screen text, click on your behalf, or change system settings.

Tiny Vow uses notification permission only for local reminders, like getting close to a vow, going over it, or still having focus time left today. Turning notifications off does not affect core features like vows, stats, or blocking.
Tiny Vow uses activity recognition only to read local step counter data for the home step summary and Pro step points. Step data stays on this device.

Tiny Vow first reads today\'s steps from your system health data source when available, then falls back to the phone step counter. Step data is used only for the home step summary and step points, and stays on this device.

Tiny Vow reads step totals from Health Connect only to show today\'s steps and calculate step encouragement points. It does not upload step data or read unrelated health records. If Health Connect is unavailable or has no step source, Tiny Vow falls back to the phone step counter.

Each score ranges from 0 to 100, and Overall is their average. Vows use completion and remaining allowance. Gains use target completion and extra progress after the target. Focus compares gains time with vow time. Rhythm checks late-night non-gains use. Restraint compares gains launches with vow launches.
60 points come from the completion ratio of vow groups.
The remaining 40 points come from remaining allowance ratio, weighted by each group\'s effective limit.
Completing any one gains group gives 60 points, and completing all of them gives 80.
The last 20 points are split evenly across gains groups, and each group starts adding its share from 1x target to 2x target.
This score uses gains-group usage divided by vow-group usage. 1x is 60 points and 2x is 100, with linear interpolation.
Only 22:00-24:00 and 00:00-04:00 count, and only for apps outside gains groups. 0h is 100, 1h is 60, and 3h is 0.
This score uses gains-group launches divided by vow-group launches. 1x is 60 points and 2x is 100, with linear interpolation.
Create a matching group to start this ring.

Vow uses only the vow group\'s base limit; extra-time cards, emergency buffers, and period reminder skips do not count. Before 20:00, Vow = progress toward the 20:00 close × vow health. Vow health stays at 100% while usage is no higher than the on-pace allowance; when usage runs ahead, it is reduced by on-pace usage ÷ actual usage. After 20:00, the ring is closed if usage stays within the base limit; over-limit usage becomes base limit ÷ actual usage. Multiple groups are averaged.
Focus = each focus group\'s current-period usage ÷ its target time, averaged across groups.
Growth = points earned today ÷ the points expected from reaching today\'s focus targets.
Steps = today\'s local step count ÷ the reward threshold set in Ring settings.
Focus time = completed focus time today ÷ the daily focus target set in Ring settings.
